t.METHYLISOTHIAZOLINONE.agn: In the EU it may not be used in leave-on products; in rinse-off products the limit is 0.0015% (15 ppm) (EU 2017/1224, Annex V entry 57). The restriction followed a rise in cases of contact allergy.
t.METHYLISOTHIAZOLINONE.eff.0: May cause contact allergy (allergic contact dermatitis); this is why the EU banned it in leave-on products.
t.METHYLISOTHIAZOLINONE.reg.0: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex V, entry 39: Permitted preservative, with an upper limit.
t.METHYLISOTHIAZOLINONE.reg.1: EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex V, entry 57: Permitted preservative, with an upper limit.
t.METHYLISOTHIAZOLINONE.summary: A potent preservative from the isothiazolinone group.
t.METHYLISOTHIAZOLINONE.what: Prevents bacteria and fungi from growing at very low concentrations.
